question: best way to quit caffeine
plausible_answers: Gradual taper using progressive decaf mixing over 4-5 weeks
Cold turkey scheduled on a weekend / holiday with pain relievers on hand
Substitute with caffeine-free alternatives plus a quit-buddy / accountability partner
